1.w: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your name bring honor, for the sake of your loyal love and faithfulness.

2.w: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”

3.w: Our God is in heaven. He does whatever he pleases.

4.w: Their idols are made of silver and gold— they are man-made.

5.w: They have mouths, but cannot speak; eyes, but cannot see;

6.w: ears, but cannot hear; noses, but cannot smell;

7.w: hands, but cannot touch; feet, but cannot walk. They cannot even clear their throats.

8.w: Those who make them will end up like them, as will everyone who trusts in them.

9.w: O Israel, trust in the Lord. He is their deliverer and protector.

10.w: O family of Aaron, trust in the Lord. He is their deliverer and protector.

11.w: You loyal followers of the Lord, trust in the Lord. He is their deliverer and protector.

12.w: The Lord takes notice of us; he will bless — he will bless the family of Israel, he will bless the family of Aaron.

13.w: He will bless his loyal followers, both young and old.

14.w: May he increase your numbers, yours and your children’s.

15.w: May you be blessed by the Lord, the Creator of heaven and earth.

16.w: The heavens belong to the Lord, but the earth he has given to mankind.

17.w: The dead do not praise the Lord, nor do any of those who descend into the silence of death.

18.w: But we will praise the Lord now and forevermore. Praise the Lord!
